The '''Velocity speeder''' was a model of [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]]. A modified version, the [[Stinger Velocity 200]], was used in the [[BlastBoast 2000]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Echnos]].
